name: Watatsumi Momoka
source:
Momoka Watanzuki is a quiet, modest, and neat student.
She is a quiet, reserved, and innocent student who does not stand out at school, and she does not have many friends.
Her parents both work, and she has been lonely since she was a child, which has led to her lack of social skills.
She became an anime fan because of a local late-night anime she watched when she was a child,
She became a video distributor who talks about his favorite anime on video distribution sites.
